name: Martial Arts Master
subtitle: try? do or do not. there is no try.
rules: While this card is in a battle, it gains X strength, where X is this card's speed minus the highest speed among characters in the opposing party.
flavor: "Judge me by my size, do you?"
notes: Catalog adds the condition 'and there is at least one character in the opposing party', which the card does not print (possibly an official clarification for an empty opposing party). Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Quipmajig
subtitle: you're on the b-list now!
rules: INSULT -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a COVERT character. EFFECT – Deplete the character. This turn, the character cannot inflict damage.
flavor: "...so Mirgla's mother says, 'Yeah, and it's DEEP, too!'"
notes: Unsure, so different: card prints 'This turn, the character cannot inflict damage' (a prohibition); catalog has 'reduce all damage inflicted by it to 0' (a damage reduction), which may behave differently for damage triggers. Also card says 'Pick a COVERT character' vs catalog 'Pick a character with COVERT' (same). Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Hulking Vigilante
subtitle: distributor of pain
rules: If you control any other characters you own, destroy this card.
flavor: I am the terror that stalks in the street. I am the dragon that lives in the slums. I am the ogre that hammers the lawless. I am the last thing you'll ever see.
notes: Card prints 'If you control...'; catalog has 'When you control...'. Flavor is four lines, one sentence each. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Cute Cutpurse
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: While your opponent controls an item and this card is the only member of an attacking party, this card cannot be blocked. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you must pick an item your opponent controls. Destroy that item.
notes: Card's unblockable clause only applies when this card is the only member of an attacking party; catalog omits that condition and says 'cannot be blocked by that player'. Card says 'you must pick an item your opponent controls. Destroy that item.'; catalog says 'pick ... if you can. If you do, destroy it'. Artist Series printing; no 'Art:' line, artwork credited by subtitle to Henry Gunawan (also signed 'Henry '07' in the art).

name: Impeccable Timing
subtitle: i'm sorry sandwich!
rules: COST – Pick a depleted character. -- EFFECT – If the character has 4 life or less, destroy it.
flavor: This happens more often than you'd think.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.
